what_was_wrong: The 'bug' and 'evidence' fields attributed the RQ5-M run-2 memory peaks to other models staying resident. Run 3 (every model unloaded and /api/ps empty before each model) gave 4,872 / 2,222 / 849 MB, essentially the same as run 2. The isolated figures (2,552 / 1,555 / 572 MB) came from only 3 requests with one prompt, so they weren't comparable.
actual_cause: Ollama 0.40.13 starts llama-server.exe without --cache-ram, so llama.cpp's default host-RAM prompt cache (up to 8,192 MiB) applies. The runner's private memory grows ~40 MB per distinct prompt (2,497 MB after 1 request -> 3,632 MB after 30, model size 2,449 MB). See artifacts/rq5_resource_profile/memory_diagnostics.json.
consequence: Run-2 memory figures were valid peaks after 121 requests, not contaminated. The unload_all() change stays (harmless, and it guarantees cold starts). Run 3 is the reported run. RQ5-M now reports both the post-load footprint and the peak after 121 requests.
